note: Trading Desk snapshot. Rewritten every market day by the after-close task. Every number carries its source in 'sources'.
headline: AI debt worries sink tech: the Nasdaq drops 2.1% and chips 3.4%, while oil lifts energy to a 52-week high

indices.name: Nasdaq 100
indices.src: Robinhood NDX quote; % vs Oct 15 NDX quote

movers.note: US stocks over $10 with more than $1.5B traded; leveraged ETFs excluded

notes.text: Tech led a broad drop: the S&P 500 fell 1.09%, the Nasdaq 2.14% and the Russell 2000 1.72%, while the Dow lost only 0.34%. The S&P tech sector fell more than 3% and nearly two-thirds of US issues declined.
AI financing worries hit the neoclouds: CoreWeave -11.9% (about $50B of debt, per TheStreet), Nebius -12.2%, IREN -11.2%. Snowflake -8.4% and Palantir -7.2%.
Chips sold off again: SMH -3.4%, AMD -6.0%, Micron -5.6%, Broadcom -4.5%, Lam -4.9%. Nvidia held up better at -1.4%.
Oil lifted energy: Brent tested $110 a barrel midday. XLE +2.5% to a 52-week high, with Chevron +2.6% and ExxonMobil +2.5% at 52-week highs too.
Money hid in defensives: utilities +1.3%, staples +1.1%, Coca-Cola +2.1%, Procter & Gamble +1.5%.
Volatility woke up: the VIX jumped 21% from 16.46 to 19.99.

econ.detail: Press conference 11:30 PT. Prediction markets ~81% hold (Oct 13).
